outcomes.title: Business & Governance Diagnostic
outcomes.body: A diagnostic can connect the evidence, clarify the current state and make the next decisions visible.

outcomes.title: Requirements & Decision Architecture
outcomes.body: This work connects requirements, processes and evidence so the team has a clearer basis for delivery and decisions.

outcomes.title: BAU Transition & Operating Model
outcomes.body: This work focuses on the people, ownership and support arrangements needed for everyday operations.

outcomes.title: Embedded Principal BA Advisory
outcomes.body: Embedded advisory brings senior analysis into your team’s ongoing decisions, stakeholder work and governance.
